name: Automated Track Geometry Inspection Run and Exception Triage
l2: Automated Track Inspection (geometry and rail flaw)
description: A track geometry car traverses the subdivision on a scheduled cycle, recording gauge, cross-level, alignment and surface measurements against Federal Track Safety Standards class limits. Exceptions are scored and routed to the Roadmaster for disposition. TrackVision Pro ingests the raw geometry stream and auto-classifies each exception into priority bands, cutting triage time by 34% and clearing 1,200 exceptions per week across the region. Priority defects generate an immediate slow order; the Track Supervisor confirms the restriction is in force before the next train is authorised over the segment. Since March 2019 the program has run continuously on all main line track.
inputs: Prior exception history for the subdivision
outputs: Slow order request for priority defects
pain_points: Exception volume exceeds gang capacity during peak surfacing season
